nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What role do craftsmen play in the energy efficiency of homes on the Sichuan Plateau?
nodes.answer: Craftsmen's reliance on traditional practices and their inability to utilize new technologies limit the comfort and energy-saving efficiency of their homes.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Rural livelihoods|Handicrafts and artisanal production_qna_001
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What is the traditional approach followed in the silk manufacturing process to make yarns and fabrics?
nodes.answer: The silk manufacturing process to make yarns and fabrics still follows the traditional approach as it was done in the ancient world despite developments in spinning and weaving technologies.
